column1: # AoE2 attack/armour CLASS id -> readable name. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for game-facts.json's
# Source: SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree js/techtree.js `attackAndArmorClasses` at pinned SHA
#   b9d494df6921d4080df69b22f9dbb7a4d1dcd9f0 (the same commit the repo pins for data.json/strings/icons).
#   HTML `<abbr>` wrappers stripped to their visible text (e.g. class 8 -> "Mounted Units").
#   This IS aoe2techtree's own tooltip vocabulary — authoritative, NOT aalises editorial text.
# Classes 3 (Base Pierce) and 4 (Base Melee) are a unit's OWN base attack, never an attack BONUS;
# refdata::game_facts skips them. A unit's Attacks entry citing a class absent here fails loud
# (RefdataError::UnknownAttackClass) rather than emitting an unnamed bonus.
